reason: I cook at home to keep oil, salt and calories down, and nothing here mentions that; massaman and pad see ew aren't what I'm trying to eat. I might try the free basil pork, but I already learn from free clips every night, so I wouldn't pay for the pack.
objection: It never says how much oil, sugar or salt goes in or how many calories a dish has. And with one pan and a tiny kitchen I'm not cooking three dishes on a Sunday, so the cook-ahead plans don't help me.
would_change_my_mind: Calories on every dish and a lighter version with less oil, salt and sugar that still works in my one pan.
